title: Air Fryer Tilapia with Fresh Lemon Pepper
description: Cook tilapia in an air fryer with this quick and easy recipe that uses homemade lemon pepper to boost the flavor of this mild, white, and flaky fish.
ingredients: 1 sprig parsley, chopped, or more to taste

steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C) for 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, rinse tilapia fillets and pat dry with a paper towel.

Mix together lemon zest, olive oil, garlic, pepper, and salt in a small bowl until well combined. Rub over tops of fillets, then sprinkle lightly with paprika. Lightly coat the air fryer basket with cooking spray. Arrange fillets evenly in the basket, spice-side up. Do not crowd; if needed, cook in batches.
Cook in the preheated air fryer until fish flakes easily with a fork, 7 to 10 minutes. Remove fillets to a plate and garnish with parsley. Serve with lemon wedges.

video.description: In this video, learn how to make delicious, flaky fish in the air fryer; it’s the perfect versatile entree. Cook this tilapia with fresh lemon pepper seasoning to amp up the flavor. Even though this seafood recipe is low carb and light, you won't sacrifice any flavor. Use your best judgment about doneness, because cook time depends on the thickness of your filets and the type of air fryer you have.
